stem: The mean of six numbers is \(15\). What is the sum of the six numbers?
solution: The mean is the sum divided by the number of values, so the sum is the mean times the number of values.
verify:
s = symbols('s')
r = solve(Eq(s / 6, 15), s)[0]
assert r == 90
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == r and len(spr_answers) == 1
